description.text:
The runner-up deck of the Masters Division at the 2019 World Championships, played by the winner of the 2016 Masters Division with Magical Symphony. It stars the Ultra Beasts Blacephalon and Naganadel: Beast Ring, Welder and Naganadel's Charging Up put lots of Energy into play for Blacephalon-GX's Mind Blown, which can take down almost any Pokémon-GX, and Heatran-GX uses that Fire Energy for a GX attack of its own. The 2019 World Championships were held at the Walter E. Washington Convention Center in Washington, D.C., in August 2019.

Pokémon sold it as one of four 2019 World Championships decks: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet, a deck box, a pin and a code card for the Pokémon Trading Card Game Online. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
